name: MorphE
source:
After their rescue from a madwoman's hellish subterranean caverns, five humans have their eyes opened to the dark truth lurking under normal society. A "benefactor" takes them in, but he's a cold-blooded killer with a deadly fixation on the new mages. In a world of magic, mages, and far creeper creatures, can he be trusted? Can anyone?

[From [url=http://www.smackjeeves.com/comicprofile.php?id=122406]Smack Jeeves[/url]]

The visual novel is set in [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mage:_The_Awakening]Mage: The Awakening[/url] universe.
translation:
从一个疯女人地狱般的地下洞穴中获救后，五个人类终于看清了潜藏在日常社会之下的黑暗真相。一位“恩人”收留了他们，却是一个冷血杀手，对这些新觉醒的法师怀有致命的执念。在这个有魔法、法师，以及更加恐怖生物的世界里，他值得信任吗？还有谁值得信任？

[来源：[url=http://www.smackjeeves.com/comicprofile.php?id=122406]Smack Jeeves[/url]]

这部视觉小说以[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mage:_The_Awakening]Mage: The Awakening[/url]的世界为背景。
